deploybot: preflight check failed for release window 2026-04-07 17:00 UTC — env-parity mismatch detected
deploybot: mismatch detail: secret key suffix normalization (staging uses `-dev`, prod uses no suffix). flagged routes: /inference, /cache-warmup
jessica: @deploybot ah ok. which service image/tag?
deploybot: service=rw-inference-runtime image=rw-runtime:2026.04.07-canary commit=aa12bc
ryan: hmm, we just bumped the keystore helper lib in that image. could be the code expecting a suffix.
priya: can someone paste the failing check output?
deploybot: ```diff
- secret path: /keystore/redwood/inference/api-key
+ secret path: /keystore/redwood/inference/api-key-dev
```
jessica: oh interesting — staging CI created keys with `-dev` suffix during our test isolation. prod keystore doesn't have the suffix.
ops-sre: @jessica @ryan what are options? rollback, hotpatch config, or add compatibility shim in runtime?
ryan: fastest is to pin the image back to previous `rw-runtime:2026.03.29` for the prod release. then we can ship the new image in a separate canary that watches keystore normalization.
priya: pinning will delay feature rollout though. are we in a change window?
jessica: yes — release window open until 18:00 UTC. if we pin now we still meet window for other non-runtime changes.
ops-sre: recommend pin + follow-up PR to add a compatibility layer (lookup both suffixed and unsuffixed keys).
infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-1478 linking keystore normalization regression and suggested shim.
ryan: I'll open the PR for shim and a unit test to assert both key forms are accepted.
priya: can we also update release notes to call out the rollback/pin and that runtime bump will be rescheduled?
jessica: yes — I'll update the release notes and add a short blurb: "Rolled back runtime image due to env-parity keystore suffix mismatch; runtime bump postponed pending keystore normalization fix."
ops-sre: decision: hold the runtime bump for prod; pin image to `rw-runtime:2026.03.29`. no full rollback needed for other services. proceed with deploy plan after pin update. :white_check_mark:
jessica: executing pin now. applying helm override: `--set image.tag=2026.03.29`
jessica: `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/rw-inference rw-inference=registry/repo/rw-runtime:2026.03.29`
deploybot: deploy check re-run in progress...
deploybot: deploy check passed — no env parity blockers remain
ops-sre: good. create postmortem blameless note in INFRA-1478 and add the compatibility fix to the next sprint.
priya: adding a note to release notes and emailing product for customer-facing comms.
ryan: will push the shim PR and link to the ticket; tagging @ops-sre for verification in canary.
jessica: closing thread once release notes updated. :thumbsup:
